title: Quoting through the IAD Catalog: the fast track to procuring technology
excerpt: Colombia Compra Eficiente's Demand Aggregation Instrument lets entities procure solutions from the Government Virtual Store without a lengthy bidding process.
content:
Colombia Compra Eficiente's Demand Aggregation Instrument lets entities procure solutions from the Government Virtual Store without a lengthy bidding process.

The timing problem

An entity identifies a technology need in March and signs a contract in December. Not out of negligence, but because of the natural length of a bidding process. By then, the need has changed.

What is the IAD?

The Demand Aggregation Instrument (IAD) is a Colombia Compra Eficiente mechanism that pools government demand and lists pre-negotiated suppliers and terms in a catalog. The entity doesn't have to structure a new process: it requests a quote and issues a purchase order from the Colombian Government Virtual Store.

The process, step by step

  • Log in to the Colombian Government Virtual Store with your entity's credentials.
  • Find the relevant catalog and the available solutions.
  • Request a quote for the scope your entity needs.
  • Issue the purchase order and begin implementation.

Weeks instead of months, with terms already negotiated by Colombia Compra Eficiente.

What you can quote from Interkont

Both IK Labs' artificial intelligence agents and COBRA's implementation and monitoring services are available through this channel. The entity chooses the implementation level that matches its maturity and scope.
